t: A tiny Linux computer about the size of a stick of gum with Wi-Fi.
steps: Buy a Zero 2 WH with a ready header from a maker shop, or a starter kit with a case and power supply.
Get a microSD card and a 2.5 A micro USB power supply.
Install the free Raspberry Pi Imager app on another computer.
Choose Raspberry Pi OS Lite in Imager and add your Wi-Fi name and password.
Insert the card and plug power into the power-only micro USB port.
Connect from your other computer over Wi-Fi with a remote terminal.
Blink an LED on the header with a short gpiozero Python example.
meta: Open Board. From $15. A few stores.
